name: Better Cores
description: Keeps the panel's tunnel cores up to date from Settings → Cores: once a day (and on a button) it looks for a newer OpenFlux, mieru or TrustTunnel, installs it in place of the panel's copy when you press Update, and puts it back after a panel update. Also the WARP engine (AmneziaWG check and endpoint scanner) that Better WARP requires.
author: AllIsA1
